{{Quote|Ohta: ex-mercenary and bounty hunter. Cast out of the Mandalorians for dishonorable conduct. He'll provide support and demolitions.|[[Bax Kholer]]|<ref name="Star Wars: The Old Republic">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''</ref>}}
'''Ohta''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] mercenary and [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] active during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. At one point, Ohta was a [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]], but he was disowned by them for unworthy behavior. Eventually he was caught by the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and sent to [[Belsavis prison]]. During the [[Invasion of Belsavis]] (around [[3641 BBY]]) he was sprung out of his cell along with three other prisoners - [[Chaney Barrow]], [[Kanjon Slyke]] and [[Paarkos]]. Their rescuer posed as a fellow inmate, but was in fact [[Imperial Intelligence (Sith Empire)|Imperial Intelligence]] operative - [[Cipher Nine]]. The prisoners released were chosen for their skills and were asked to provide the means to break into the [[Megasecurity Ward 23]]. Ohta was slain by the Cipher, serving as an example to the rest of the group. 

To avoid the attention of [[SCORPIO]] security system, the rest of the prisoners and the Cipher came up with a plan to reprogram security droids and order them to cause havoc, thus triggering multiple alarms at different locations at once, overloading SCORPIO's capabilities. The plan eventually worked, though SCORPIO managed to disconnect herself from the network and upload her consciousness back into her [[Droid/Legends|droid]] body.

==Behind the scenes==
Ohta can be killed by the player at their first confrontation if the player picks the dark side option. If Otha is kept alive, he and Slyke band together against Chaney while the player is infiltrating Megasecurity Ward 23.
